property_summary: For any target address and amount, C.sendMoney will revert (propagate failure) when the callee's fallback reverts; the mutant ignores the call result and therefore can succeed (not revert) for some inputs when the callee reverts.
change_summary: Replace the call-with-return handling to ignore the returned success and data and always attempt a low-level call without checking result, removing revert on failure.
